facts.fact: 章首：树精朝 Andra 扔橡子取笑，她接住扔回去又被撒一头树叶，气骂
facts.anchor: Andra massaged the tender spot on top of her head, glaring up at the mischievous creatures in the branches above.

facts.fact: Lucas 是她表亲（cousin）首次点明；这样的下跳她做过上千次
facts.anchor: as she hit the earth in front of her cousin. Something she’d done a thousand times before.

facts.fact: Lucas 说父亲要他帮忙筹备庆典、猎南方林最大野猪，早餐须缩短
facts.anchor: My father asked me to help him prepare for the celebration tonight. Something about hunting the largest boar the Southern Woods has ever seen.

facts.fact: 纪念日双重含义：村民庆祝光魔法胜利，Andra 悼念母亲
facts.anchor: While the villagers celebrate light magic’s victory, I mourn my mother.

facts.fact: 回忆遇袭夜：陌生男人獠牙咬进母亲脖颈——母亲遇害来历
facts.anchor: A strange man with greedy hands and an insatiable appetite sinking his fangs into her mother’s neck.

facts.fact: Andra 徒手元素魔法展示（火星烧黑 Lucas 裤子）
facts.anchor: She huffed, sending sparks from her fingers onto his trousers, where small black marks appeared.

facts.fact: Bernice 自 Lucas 出生起就认识他；袭击后长期照拂 Andra
facts.anchor: Lucas, I have known you since the day you were born. How many times do I have to tell you to call me Bernice?

facts.fact: 市集路上遇约五岁女孩 Lydia，摔伤前臂流血
facts.anchor: She looked around five years of age, with untidy hair and black-stained feet to match.

facts.fact: 高价天蓝愈合药水顷刻闭合伤口；Lydia 称她 my hero
facts.anchor: In a matter of moments, the wound was closed, leaving only a thin pink line on Lydia’s arm.

facts.fact: 生命之力流入压扁的花束复原本——把摔坏的礼物复原
facts.anchor: Life flowed through her hands and into the flowers, stems straightening and petals brightening once more.

facts.fact: 集市配药指导（混猪血、每晚月出涂、四天疹消）；备货两周近售空
facts.anchor: Mix this with pig’s blood and rub it on the tender skin every evening at moonrise. The rash will clear up within four days.

facts.fact: 章末悬念：黑兜帽身影静立树下盯着她，鸡群骚乱后消失
facts.anchor: A being in a black hood stood silently amongst the trunks, watching her.
